name: Owari Yuki
source:
The heroine lost her memory when she was a child so she doesn't know anything about her childhood. She was invited to come back to her childhood home by her aunt.

[from [url=http://forum.my-neoromance.com/index.php?/topic/425-self-made-otome-games/page__view__findpost__p__9440]a forum post by Hazuki[/url]]
translation:
女主人公幼年时失去了记忆，因此对自己的童年一无所知。一天，姑母邀请她回到儿时居住过的家。

[摘自Hazuki发布的[url=http://forum.my-neoromance.com/index.php?/topic/425-self-made-otome-games/page__view__findpost__p__9440]论坛帖子[/url]]
